from typing import Optional, Literal

import torch
from pydantic import Field

from asr_service.backends.base_options import BaseOptions
from asr_service.constants import LANGUAGE_KEY_TYPE, K_REALTIME, K_ALIGN, K_TRANSCRIBE, K_DIARIZE, K_IDENTIFY
from asr_service.lib.platform import Platform


class TranscribeOptions(BaseOptions):
    process_type: Literal[K_TRANSCRIBE] = K_TRANSCRIBE
    hf_token: Optional[str] = Field(default=None,
                                    description="Hugging Face Access Token to access gated models")
    model_dir: Optional[str] = Field(default=None,
                                     description="The path to save model files")
    cache_dir: Optional[str] = Field(default=None,
                                     description="The path to cache model files")
    model: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Name of the model to use")

    device: Optional[str] = Field(default_factory=lambda: "cuda" if Platform.is_gpu_available() else "cpu",
                                  description="device to use for PyTorch inference")
    device_index: Optional[int] = Field(default=0, description="device index to use for FasterWhisper inference")

    language: Optional[LANGUAGE_KEY_TYPE] = Field(default=None,
                                                  description="language spoken in the audio, specify None to perform language detection")

    batch_size: Optional[int] = Field(1, ge=1,
                                      description="The preferred batch size for inference")

    threads: Optional[int] = Field(default=1, ge=1,
                                   description="Number of threads used by torch for CPU inference; supercedes MKL_NUM_THREADS/OMP_NUM_THREADS")

    compute_type: Optional[Literal["float16", "float32", "int8"]] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: "int8" if not Platform.is_gpu_available() else "float16" if
        torch.cuda.get_device_capability(torch.cuda.current_device())[0] >= 7 else "float32",
        description="compute type for computation")

    @property
    def torch_dtype(self) -> Optional[str]:
        """Backward-compatible name used by older Voxtral configurations."""
        return self.compute_type

    def torch_device(self) -> Optional[str]:
        """``device`` with the index appended, for the torch side models.

        ctranslate2 rejects "cuda:1" and wants ``device_index`` separately, so the
        two are kept apart in this model and only joined for torch, where a bare
        "cuda" would silently resolve to whatever the current device happens to
        be."""
        if self.device and self.device.startswith("cuda") and ":" not in self.device \
            and self.device_index is not None:
            return f"{self.device}:{self.device_index}"
        return self.device


class AlignOptions(BaseOptions):
    process_type: Literal[K_ALIGN] = K_ALIGN

    align: Optional[bool] = Field(default=True, description="Do perform phoneme alignment")


class DiarizeOptions(BaseOptions):
    process_type: Literal[K_DIARIZE] = K_DIARIZE

    diarize: Optional[bool] = Field(default=True,
                                    description="Apply diarization to assign speaker labels to each segment/word")


class IdentifyOptions(BaseOptions):
    """Speaker identification: map the per-file diarization labels onto persistent
    identities by comparing their voice profiles against a store of known ones."""
    process_type: Literal[K_IDENTIFY] = K_IDENTIFY

    identify: Optional[bool] = Field(default=False,
                                     description="Assign persistent speaker identities to the diarized speakers. "
                                                 "Voice profiles are biometric data - only enable where there is a "
                                                 "legal basis for storing them.")

    store: Optional[Literal["sql"]] = Field(default="sql",
                                            description="Backend holding the known voice profiles")
    collection: Optional[str] = Field(default="default",
                                      description="Profile namespace to match against, e.g. one per tenant or project")

    accept_threshold: Optional[float] = Field(default=0.70, ge=-1.0, le=1.0,
                                              description="Cosine similarity at or above which a profile is accepted "
                                                          "as the same speaker. Calibrate on your own recordings; the "
                                                          "default is deliberately conservative.")
    reject_threshold: Optional[float] = Field(default=0.55, ge=-1.0, le=1.0,
                                              description="Cosine similarity below which a speaker is treated as "
                                                          "unknown. Between the two thresholds the match is considered "
                                                          "ambiguous and no identity is assigned.")

    min_speech_duration: Optional[float] = Field(default=5.0, ge=0.0,
                                                 description="Minimum net speech in seconds a diarized speaker needs "
                                                             "before it is identified or enrolled. Short clusters "
                                                             "produce unreliable profiles.")

    auto_enroll: Optional[bool] = Field(default=True,
                                        description="Enroll unmatched speakers as new identities. Disable to only "
                                                    "recognise speakers that were enrolled explicitly.")
    update_profiles: Optional[bool] = Field(default=True,
                                            description="Add the observed profile as an additional vector of a matched "
                                                        "identity, so it covers more recording conditions over time")
    max_vectors_per_speaker: Optional[int] = Field(default=20, ge=1,
                                                   description="Vectors kept per identity; the oldest is dropped when "
                                                               "the limit is reached")


class RealtimeOptions(BaseOptions):
